key_findings: Suppression closes the ACK-mode channel timing normalization could not: ack_only 0.759->0.482 (mode only); suppress+timing reaches the size-only floor (all 0.501 ~ oracle 0.500).

Safe hold-then-decide is architecturally IMPOSSIBLE as a tc-egress DROP (can't cancel a queued skb; ACK egresses before the response). Realizable inline only as immediate predictive TC_ACT_SHOT -- irreversible, proactive fail-open only.
The safe behaviour IS realizable as SOCKET-SIDE COALESCING where we own the socket -- WIRE-DEMONSTRATED (is_separate 100%->0%, byte-identical, 0 drops), no BPF.
Static TCP headers (TTL 64 / window 29200 / MSS 1460 / wscale 7) IDENTICAL across the 3 devices -> p0f static fingerprinting does not distinguish them.
Suppression DROP is Tofino-NATIVE (mark_to_drop, line-rate) -- the portable half, inverse of the Tofino-hostile EDT hold.
supported_claims: Socket-side coalescing normalizes the request ACK mode separate->combined on the actual wire, byte-preservingly, with zero dropped packets (measured; single-server demo AND per-device defended-wire eval).

Per-device DEFENDED-WIRE eval (loopback reproduction of measured observables): coalescing removes SEL-751's separate-ACK tell on the wire (ack_only 0.728->0.389; joint all 1.000->0.767), collapsing SEL-751<->AB1400; ION7550 stays size-identified -> SIZE is the confirmed residual. Byte-identical 2160/2160; 0 retrans/reset/dup-ACK.

TWO-HOST RIG confirmation (real Vision<->Hulk hardware, Hulk replays real device bytes over the 1G net): reproduces the loopback finding -- joint all 1.000->0.756->0.681, ack_only 0.751->0.524->0.317, size floor 0.667, SEL-751<->AB1400 collapse, ION7550 stays size-identified; client 2160/2160 byte-identical, 0 retrans/reset on real NICs. NOT the physical devices (a reproduction on real hardware).

In the trace-transformation eval, ACK suppression closes the ACK-mode channel (ack_only 0.759->0.482); suppression + timing normalization reaches the size-only floor (all 0.856->0.501 ~ oracle 0.500).
The safe hold-then-decide behaviour is realizable at the socket (coalescing), not as a tc-egress drop; the inline egress drop is limited to an irreversible immediate TC_ACT_SHOT.
The suppression drop is Tofino-native (mark_to_drop) -- the portable half of the obfuscation line.
Static TCP-header fingerprinting does not distinguish these three devices (measured from the SYNs).
